city_name: Búzios, Cabo Frio & Arraial do Cabo (Costa do Sol), Brazil

boarding_points.name: Píer Central de Búzios (Rua das Pedras / Orla Bardot)
boarding_points.operator: Prefeitura de Armação dos Búzios (Secretaria de Turismo)
boarding_points.notes: Main town pier at the foot of Rua das Pedras; cruise tender landing (26 calls / 76,276 pax Jan 2026) and escuna departure point. Coordinate is the OSM pier way at the Rua das Pedras waterfront — pier is unnamed in OSM; confirm exact berth at survey.

boarding_points.name: Porto Veleiro Búzios (Praia da Armação)
boarding_points.notes: Second cruise tender pier (~1 km from Píer Central per Secretaria de Turismo posts) and escuna/dive-boat embarkation on Praia da Armação. Named node in OSM.

boarding_points.name: Marina Porto Búzios (BR Marinas, Manguinhos/Praia Rasa)
boarding_points.notes: Full-service marina on the sheltered west side of the Búzios peninsula; homeport for the private-lancha charter fleet; natural charging-pedestal anchor (same operator group as Angra/Verolme marinas). OSM 'BR Marinas Búzios' with three mapped piers.

boarding_points.name: Porto da Barra (Manguinhos)
boarding_points.operator: Porto da Barra (private gastronomic/leisure pier complex)
boarding_points.notes: Waterfront dining/leisure pier village on Manguinhos beach — premium sunset-arrival spur. Coordinate is the OSM pier way; Nominatim places the named complex entrance ~240 m east on Av. José Bento Ribeiro Dantas.
boarding_points.source: OpenStreetMap pier way -22.76923,-41.91350; Nominatim 'Porto da Barra, Búzios' -22.76930,-41.91116

boarding_points.name: Marina dos Pescadores / Cais da Praia dos Anjos (Arraial do Cabo)
boarding_points.operator: FIPAC (Fundação Instituto de Pesca de Arraial do Cabo, municipal)
boarding_points.notes: The departure point for virtually all Arraial tour boats, escunas and taxi-boats; mandatory FIPAC vessel registration (Resolução 32/2025); larger tour vessels carry up to 80 pax. Coordinate is the OSM 'Embarque de Passageiros' node within the mapped Marina da Praia dos Anjos / Píer da Marina dos Anjos complex.

boarding_points.name: Praia do Farol beach landing (Ilha do Cabo Frio)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Arraial do Cabo (Ilha do Cabo Frio)
boarding_points.notes: No pier — authorized-vessel beach landing only. Navy IEAPM norms (Portaria 46/2017) cap Praia do Farol at 300 concurrent visitors with controlled disembark/re-embark; shallow-draft, low-wake craft are a natural fit. Coordinate is the OSM/Nominatim beach centroid.
boarding_points.source: https://assets.marinha.mil.br/ieapm/sites/www.marinha.mil.br.ieapm/files/Normas%20para%20acesso%20a%20Ilha%20do%20Cabo%20Frio.pdf ; Nominatim 'Praia do Farol, Arraial do Cabo'

boarding_points.name: Iate Clube do Rio de Janeiro — Cabo Frio station (Canal do Itajuru mouth)
boarding_points.operator: Iate Clube do Rio de Janeiro (ICRJ)
boarding_points.notes: ICRJ's Cabo Frio outpost on Rua Almirante Barroso near the Canal do Itajuru mouth and Forte São Mateus — the natural sea-side node for inter-town runs (clears the canal immediately).
boarding_points.source: Nominatim/OSM 'Iate Clube do Rio de Janeiro, Rua Almirante Barroso, Cabo Frio' -22.88404,-42.00630

boarding_points.name: Costa Azul Iate Clube (Canal do Itajuru, Gamboa)
boarding_points.notes: Century-old club and marina on the Canal do Itajuru boulevard waterfront — the in-town Cabo Frio boarding node closest to the Boulevard Canal restaurant strip.
boarding_points.source: Nominatim/OSM 'Costa Azul Iate Clube, Cabo Frio' -22.87726,-42.02104

boarding_points.name: Clube do Canal (Canal do Itajuru)
boarding_points.notes: Mid-canal marina/club on the Itajuru waterway; secondary in-town spur node. Named marina in OSM.
boarding_points.source: OpenStreetMap 'Clube do Canal' -22.87060,-42.03017; TripAdvisor Itajuru Waterway listing

boarding_points.name: Marina Marlin (Canal do Itajuru, west end)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Cabo Frio (Portinho / Lagoa de Araruama end of canal)
boarding_points.notes: Westernmost mapped marina on the canal toward the Lagoa de Araruama — inner terminus of the canal transit spur. Named marina in OSM.

boarding_points.name: Marina Porto Real (Cabo Frio) — UNVERIFIED
boarding_points.notes: Local lancha-tour operators advertise departures 'da Marina Porto Real' with Cabo Frio itineraries (Canal do Itajuru, Ilha do Japonês, Forte São Mateus), but the name collides with the well-known Marina Porto Real in Mangaratiba (Costa Verde) and no authoritative coordinate could be verified in OSM/Nominatim or an official page. Coordinates withheld — verify existence and location at survey before rendering.
